description: This file contains UI instrumentation tests for MainActivity of an Android application, implemented using Espresso. Tests cover form validation, submission flow, list ordering, theming, and toast messages.

classes.name: MainActivityUiTest
classes.description: Instrumentation test class for MainActivity UI using Espresso, testing validation, submission, list view updates, theming, and error handling.

methods.name: form_validation_enablesButtonOnlyWhenBothFieldsHaveText
methods.description: Tests that the submit button remains disabled until both input fields have text, then becomes enabled.

methods.name: submit_addsItem_clearsFields_showsSuccessToast_andListOrdersLatestFirst
methods.description: Tests submitting feedback adds an item, clears form fields, displays success toast, and verifies list order and badge visibility.

methods.name: invalid_submit_showsErrorToast_andNoListChange
methods.description: Tests that submitting without input shows an error toast and does not change the list.

methods.name: theme_button_hasPrimaryTint
methods.description: Verifies that the submit button exists, is visible, and is themed with primary tint, along with title views.

methods.name: scenarioOnDecorView
methods.description: Utility method to run a block with decor view reference for UI assertions like toast detection.

methods.name: listHasCount
methods.description: Matcher to verify the number of items in a ListView.

methods.name: listItemTextAtPosition
methods.description: Matcher to verify specific text within a list item at a given position.

methods.name: listItemVisibilityAtPosition
methods.description: Matcher to verify the visibility of a child view within a list item at a specific position.
